_OCC_REPO_NAME = "onex_change_control"
_OCC_REPO_OWNER = "OmniNode-ai"


def _is_occ_repo(repo: str) -> bool:
    normalized = repo.strip().rstrip("/")
    if "/" in normalized:
        owner, name = normalized.rsplit("/", maxsplit=1)
        return owner == _OCC_REPO_OWNER and name == _OCC_REPO_NAME
    return normalized == _OCC_REPO_NAME
